title: IVTC sb-tuning decision table
purpose: Operationalises the FFmpeg pullup sb parameter trade-off (documented in art_01M6W95VGW89J83N9D1VQP2TPQ r1) into testable, comparable thresholds. Pairs format checks (ffprobe) with frame-level checks (idet) and motion discontinuity counts, so sb selection is based on measured outcomes rather than visual impression alone.
attribution: Vera — decision table and threshold proposal
Source: art_01M6W95VGW89J83N9D1VQP2TPQ r1, FFmpeg pullup documentation (documentary review)
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
